title: probability-theory
description: A [0,1]-valued positing of evidence over events: a measure assigning graded charge to the events of a sample space, generated by the posit morphism where value enters predication by evidence.

events.description: a sigma-algebra of subsets of Omega, closed under complement and countable union

measure.description: the probability measure P: events -> [0,1], a valuation admitting evidence as a graded charge

normalized.description: P(Omega) = 1 and P(emptyset) = 0: the certain event weighted one, the impossible event zero

countablyAdditive.description: for pairwise-disjoint events A_i, P(union A_i) = sum P(A_i)
